sourceNote: NO PRIMARY DATA EXISTS FOR THIS ERA. A dedicated 2026 research pass found no counted pull-rate study for any Black & White set. The only figures in circulation trace to a single 2017 retailer hobby blog which gives ultra rares ~1:36 packs in Black & White improving to ~1:18 by Noble Victories and secret rares ~1:72, with no sample, no method and no attribution - folklore. Nothing primary was found either to support or to contradict it. The rates below (ultra_rare 0.05/pack, hyper_rare 0.014/pack) are the site's own model built on that folklore. The era's chase pool is genuinely thin - the 2011 base-era sets had no Pokemon-EX - so the EV here rests on very few cards, which makes it sensitive to any single price. PRICE CAVEAT: sealed Black & White boxes trade as vintage; their market price reflects scarcity and nostalgia, not pack contents.
